![](discover-logo.png){width=96px style="border-radius: 22px;"}

Discover is an iPhone app that follows the road and tells you about the places you pass: the castle ahead,
the village on your left, what happened here. It speaks when something is worth a sentence and stays quiet
the rest of the time. Hold the button to ask it anything.

## What it does

- **Knows what is coming up.** It works out which places you are approaching, on which side, and how soon,
  and announces each one once, shortly before you see it.
- **Grounded, not invented.** Every narration is built from what the guide just read: Wikipedia in the local
  language, Wikivoyage for the character of the area, a live web search for what encyclopedias miss. It says
  when the record does not say.
- **Made for the car.** Narration keeps going with the screen locked, plays through the car speakers, and
  the steering-wheel buttons control it: pause stops the guide, next skips to the following place.
- **Your interests, your narrator, your language.** Add subjects you care about and it points out places a
  general guide would drive past. Three narrators, seven languages, your choice of how often it speaks.

## It needs two keys

The words come from Claude, by Anthropic, and the voice from ElevenLabs. You pay each of them directly for
what you use: about $0.30 an hour of driving for the words, and an ElevenLabs plan for the voice (the free
plan gives about ten minutes of speech a month; Starter, $5, about thirty; Creator, $22, about two hours).
Your questions are turned into text on the phone itself. The app is free and has no account, no server
and no subscription. To connect it:

1. Create a free account at [console.anthropic.com](https://console.anthropic.com/login). This is
   Anthropic's developer console, separate from the Claude app.
2. Add some credit under [Billing](https://console.anthropic.com/settings/billing). $5 lasts many hours.
   It is prepaid: when it runs out the guide goes quiet and nothing more is charged.
3. Create a key under [API keys](https://console.anthropic.com/settings/keys) and copy it.
4. Create an account at [elevenlabs.io](https://elevenlabs.io/app/sign-up), pick a plan under
   [Subscription](https://elevenlabs.io/app/subscription), and create a key under
   [API keys](https://elevenlabs.io/app/settings/api-keys).
5. Open Discover and paste each key into its card. The app checks each key and tells you if it works.

## Common questions

**The guide says "the key was refused".** The key was mistyped, deleted, expired, or copied incompletely.
Create a new one and paste it again in Settings.

**The guide says "the account has no credit".** Add credit under Billing in the Anthropic console, or
check your ElevenLabs plan's remaining characters.

**It is quiet.** Most of a drive is quiet on purpose: the guide speaks when something worth a sentence is
coming up. Add subjects under Settings → Special interests, or set Chattiness to Often. In a tunnel or a dead
zone it picks up again on its own.

**It stops when I lock the phone.** Allow location access "Always" in the iPhone Settings app under Discover,
and leave the app running.

**Can I change the voice?** Yes. Settings → Voice lists every voice on your ElevenLabs account, the model
that reads it, and its stability, similarity and style.

**What does it cost me?** Settings → Spend shows an estimate for today and this month, computed on the phone
from what Anthropic reports and the characters ElevenLabs spoke.

## Your data

There is no Discover server and no account with us. See the [privacy policy](privacy.qmd).
